view: Haojing Western Zhou archaeological excavation quiet close oblique view of low broad rammed-earth foundation platform with visible compacted strata and shallow post-base impressions, small ceramic drainage channel exposed at side, Wei valley plain background, no standing palace or pagoda, no Qin terracotta army.

eras.title: The footprint of a Zhou building
eras.caption: At Haojing, excavated rammed-earth foundations outline large buildings of the Western Zhou capital. The timber structures have disappeared, but the platforms and drainage remains help explain how their rooms and courtyards were arranged.
